proof_scope: live monitor tick plus move-reconciliation contract

claims.proves: sanity (136 tests) passes; against live Herdr, a running agent moved by ops-herdr keeps its cooldown and no-change strikes when reconciled onto its new pane id; a dry run never writes; chained moves resolve to the final id; and the missing-receipts, malformed-receipt, empty-id-map and corrupt-state paths all fail closed
claims.does_not_prove: that a real stalled agent is correctly classified in production, nor any Tau projection behaviour

cases.name: reconcile-rejects-malformed-receipt
command: cd .. && d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$d/r" "$d/s" && printf 'not json' > "$d/r/broken.json" && printf '{"prompts":{}}' > "$d/s/state.json" && ./run.sh reconcile-moves --receipts "$d/r" --state "$d/s/state.json"

cases.name: reconcile-rejects-receipt-without-id-map
command: cd .. && d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$d/r" "$d/s" && printf '{"schema":"herdr.space_operation_receipt.v1","created_at":"x","id_map":{}}' > "$d/r/r.json" && printf '{"prompts":{}}' > "$d/s/state.json" && ./run.sh reconcile-moves --receipts "$d/r" --state "$d/s/state.json"

cases.name: reconcile-refuses-corrupt-monitor-state
command: cd .. && d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$d/r" "$d/s" && printf '{"schema":"herdr.space_operation_receipt.v1","created_at":"2026-01-01","id_map":{"a:1":"b:1"}}' > "$d/r/receipt.json" && printf 'garbage' > "$d/s/state.json" && ./run.sh reconcile-moves --receipts "$d/r" --state "$d/s/state.json"

cases.name: reconcile-collapses-chained-moves-to-final-id
command: cd .. && d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$d/r" "$d/s" && printf '{"schema":"herdr.space_operation_receipt.v1","created_at":"2026-01-01","id_map":{"a:1":"b:1"}}' > "$d/r/1.json" && printf '{"schema":"herdr.space_operation_receipt.v1","created_at":"2026-01-02","id_map":{"b:1":"c:1"}}' > "$d/r/2.json" && printf '{"prompts":{"a:1":{"last_prompt_epoch":5}}}' > "$d/s/state.json" && ./run.sh reconcile-moves --receipts "$d/r" --state "$d/s/state.json" --apply && grep -q '"c:1"' "$d/s/state.json" && ! grep -q '"a:1"' "$d/s/state.json"
